description: Generic options for where we do not have a record for a specific institution.

field_descriptions.id: A unique identified for this institution
field_descriptions.name: The full name of the institution
field_descriptions.suggestion_synonyms: A list of common alternative names that *may* be appropriate for this institution
field_descriptions.match_synonyms: A list of common alternative names that are equivalent to this institution. An answer matching a match synonym can be safely matched to this institution.
field_descriptions.dttp_id: The ID used for this institution in DTTP
field_descriptions.hesa_itt_code: The HESA DEGEST code for this instutition (see [DEGEST](https://www.hesa.ac.uk/collection/c22053/e/degest) docs)
field_descriptions.ukprn: The ID of this institution in the UK Register of Learning Providers
field_descriptions.closed: If present, the year in which the institution closed or stopped awarding degrees
field_descriptions.has_never_awarded_degrees: If present and true, the institution has never awarded degrees, was included in an earlier version of this list by mistake, and is kept purely to support interpretation of legacy data
field_descriptions.comment: Editor's comments on the entry (not necessarily of interest to external users of the data)
field_descriptions.institution_groups: The groups to which the institution belongs
